fact: Loi n° 05-20 on cybersecurity (dahir n° 1-20-69 of 25 July 2020, Bulletin officiel n° 6906 of 6 August 2020) is promulgated; its article 53 makes it operative on publication of its implementing texts, and the page says décret n° 2-24-921 applying article 25 was in force by the Bulletin officiel of 20 February 2025.

fact: The DGSN says 415 people were arrested and referred to court for technology-related and online blackmail crimes in 2025.
The DGSN's annual report, presented 17 December 2025, counts 13,643 cybercrime cases handled in 2025.
UNCTAD's Cyberlaw Tracker lists Law No. 07-03 of 11 November 2003 as Morocco's cybercrime legislation (survey round 2026-11-10; law year 2003).
Le Matin reports the National Defence Administration is working on a revision of Morocco's existing cybersecurity law to adapt it to sector developments.
We Are Tech Africa, citing DGSN data relayed by the Observatoire national de la criminalite, reports 8,333 cybercrime cases in 2024 against 5,969 in 2023, without naming a law.
